note: Every outcome a person's traits should shape outside a choice between options, the engine that owns it, and whether that engine reads the trait in play. The trait-wiring matrix (scripts/traits/trait-wiring-matrix.ts) joins these rows with the researched effect sizes in data/research/trait-effect-sizes.json. Outcome-web links are not listed here: their personality moderators belong to the outcome web.

outcomes.title: Traits drawn to real norms by age and sex
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/opening-personality.ts:1 (latent standard scores with sourced NEO facet age and sex differences, cut at 10/20/40/20/10)

outcomes.title: Traits correlate with each other as in real people
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/opening-personality.ts:73 (registered correlated pairs) and ANCHORED loadings at :31

outcomes.title: Children resemble their parents
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/births-people.ts:102 draws a newborn from its parents' inherited parts (regenerated from the seed, the same parts the opening drew); measured parent-child correlation in two drawn places (buildBenchWorld seeds herit1 and herit2, 78 and 192 pairs): 0.03 to 0.34 by dimension, mean 0.18, against 0.20 to 0.28 expected from a heritability of 0.40 (Vukasovic & Bratko 2015)
outcomes.note: A counted newborn inherits by the same rule from its counted parents' kept levels (inheritedTemperament in src/core2/opening-personality.ts).

outcomes.title: Traits change slowly with age (maturity)
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/modules/trait-change.ts:249 (each birthday moves the hidden scores along the opening age curves; counted people are caught up at fill-in, SG-TRAITS-counted-no-maturity)

outcomes.title: An ordinary worker's performance at work
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/modules/jobs.ts:1319 howTheyWork: a business values a worker by their lean toward diligence (jobs.value-worker, traitWeightJobsValueWorker sized from Barrick & Mount 1991, r 0.22) when it ranks applicants (jobs.ts:2056) and when it lets a worker go (jobs.ts:1366). Played: Oak Grove, Oregon (4153900), seed 427e8d601b48ca1ab600d7c7efb7407962876546823fbe28f7f06a1e304432fa, layoff job-change:2025-03-01:work-relationship_129ba20d7adbab65:layoff let person_43cf7cae695a94c6 go for how they work while a worker with less tenure was kept.

outcomes.title: Promotion and pay by temperament
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/modules/jobs.ts:1758 raisePay: on each job's yearly review a business adds to the market's move the return to the worker's tenure and how it reads their work (withinJobRaise, jobs.ts:1676; the work read is howTheyWork, jobs.ts:1319, through jobs.value-worker), sized from the tenure-wage and merit-raise research (jobsTenureReturnFull, jobsTenureReturnYears, jobsRaisePerWorkYear), in the share the business's memory of losses leaves it; the payroll pays the raised rate. Earlier channels stay: diligent people are hired sooner and let go later. Played: Aiea, Hawaii (1500550), seed 125c9f1ddf75bae0921d924b509a850dede48872f2fec473eaf9a3e8bdba0102, both raised in full at 0.948 years' tenure: pay-change:2026-01-01:work-relationship_b6c2f155e9938148 raised person_4d08aadd62909039 (how they work 4.400) from 1798 to 1915 cents an hour, pay-change:2026-01-01:work-relationship_224945d30e8f1354 raised person_dea9c6e0ad2bbce0 (-3.617) from 2192 to 2305, against a market move of 3.1 percent each (test src/core2/jobs-pay-growth.traits.test.ts).

outcomes.title: How much a person trusts others
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/modules/views.ts:409 (the hearer's lean toward trusting scales how far they trust a speaker in standingWith)
outcomes.size: 0.25 (ESTIMATED): the hearer's lean correlates 0.20 with their trust, as agreeableness does with the Interpersonal Trust Scale (Sindermann et al. 2021).

outcomes.title: How easily a person's view moves when they hear an argument
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/modules/views.ts:619 (the hearer's lean toward yielding scales the stance change an argument or story makes)
outcomes.size: 0.3 (ESTIMATED): the most yielding third is moved 1.37 times as far as the least, as openness raises the odds of being moved (Hibbing, Ritchie and Anderson 2011).

outcomes.title: How strongly a person reacts to news
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/modules/views.ts:619 (a printed story reaches readers as a news.read event through the same stance change); the mood side reads the event-felt trait term already wired

outcomes.title: How a person copes with hardship (job loss, debt, eviction)
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/emotion.ts:257 marks the part of a layoff's, an eviction's or a missed payment's stress that a hardship put there (Affect.hardship; kinds in content.json hardshipEventKinds), and src/core2/modules/credit.ts:1115 gives a missed loan payment the layoff's Holmes and Rahe size; src/core2/trait-decisions.ts:466 hardshipStress reads it, decayed to the day, for the three coping decisions: src/core2/jobs-benefits.ts:221 filingDecision (jobs-benefits.file-claim, weight 1.0 from Whittaker et al. 2010), src/core2/modules/credit.ts:859 personalBorrowingDecision (credit.borrow, 0.8 from Sullivan 2008 and the move and claim sizes) and src/core2/modules/moves.ts:470 pushesOf (moves.move-away, 0.6 from Huttunen, Moen and Salvanes 2018); rows outcome.hardship-coping in data/research/trait-effect-sizes.json, tests src/core2/hardship-coping.traits.test.ts. Played year on the merged head (buildBenchWorld, twoLevel, every module, 2025-01-20 to 2026-01-20), University of California-Davis, California (place key 0681302, world seed 19d99c854e45d0d7a1cf22f1a75d760532568cd88f13bd6813a7c2d08845a6d6): person_724c78e06c1255b2 lost a job on 2025-06-01 (event:work.job-lost:2025-06-01:work-relationship_b9a5a6ad766e7575), filed claim:person_724c78e06c1255b2:2025-06-01 whose reasons name hardshipStress 0.323, and left town the next day, person.moved-away:person_724c78e06c1255b2:2025-06-02, whose reasons name push:hardshipStress 0.194 beside push:housingCost 0.875 (lean toward moving +0.744). In the same month person_029993064024f0e8, evicted 2025-05-24 (event:housing.eviction:eviction:rent:household_2b191d1ce1a15f48:2025-05-06) and leaning as far as a lean goes toward staying (-1.00), stayed through the year: pulls row person_029993064024f0e8 on 2025-06-02 names push hardshipStress 0.228. A counted person reads it at the day of their layoff claim only (SG-TRAITS-counted-hardship-stress).
